app.name: Forge Env
app.tagline: Soft industrial control room for runtimes.
app.description: A Tauri shell for language versions, mirrors, PATH policy, and project detection.

sidebar.noTask: No running task. Runtime, mirror, and dependency actions require confirmation before they mutate the host.

topbar.description: Current build covers host discovery, runtime state, project inspection, mirror presets, system dependency checks, and host-aware export/import workflows. Runtime, mirror, dependency, and environment actions now call real local tools, with import plans able to reconstruct matching hosts from an exported bundle. .NET SDK install plus project pinning, and C/C++ toolchain template install plus preset hints, are now included in the runtime surface.

overview.architectureDesc: Cards stay shallow, focus rings remain explicit, and the interface caps itself at three elevation levels so the developer tool reads like an instrument panel rather than a skeuomorphic toy.

runtimePolicy.python: pyenv plus pip, pipenv, and poetry.
runtimePolicy.node: Volta as cross-platform runtime anchor, not nvm.
runtimePolicy.rust: rustup and cargo, first-class across all three desktop OS targets.
runtimePolicy.java: SDKMAN! as the preferred Unix-side manager, with Maven and Gradle detected as companion tooling.
runtimePolicy.go: Official toolchain baseline first, with gvm treated as optional rather than required.
runtimePolicy.dotnet: Official user-space SDK install is available, while global.json remains the project pinning surface for activation.
runtimePolicy.php: phpbrew for managed versions, with Composer treated as companion tooling.
runtimePolicy.ruby: rbenv plus ruby-build, with gems and Bundler layered above the selected runtime.
runtimePolicy.cpp: Host compiler and build toolchain inspection only, with clang/gcc/MSVC and CMake/Ninja surfaced without mutation.

projects.notManageable: Forge Env can inspect this family, but its provider is not yet in a manageable state on the selected host.

systemDeps.snapshotDescription: Forge Env snapshots the raw data directory into managed tar.gz archives. Redis, PostgreSQL, and MySQL must be stopped before backup, export, or restore.

systemDeps.snapshotWarning: Stop the service before restoring a backup. The snapshot archive will be unpacked directly into the managed data directory.
systemDeps.templateDesc: This entry point now calls the detected package manager directly. It does not try to elevate privileges for you, so native package manager permission rules still apply.
